info.name: Insurance Policy & Claim Management System - Full API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Insurance Policy and Claim Management System (Spring Boot), covering every controller endpoint with realistic, internally-consistent seed data.

SEED DATASET INCLUDED (run top-to-bottom, folder by folder):

- 1 Admin (pre-seeded): [admin@gmail.com](https://mailto:admin@gmail.com) / admin123
    
- 2 Internal Staff members: Karan Mehta, Simran Kaur
    
- 3 Customers: Nishtha Srivastava, Mishti Dhyani, Vydehi Peddi
    
- 4 Insurance Products (SRS categories): Health Shield, Motor Secure, Life Secure, Travel Safe
    
- 16 Policy Plans (4 tiers per product, one of each premium type: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, ANNUAL, ONE_TIME)
    
- 3 Policies: 2 self-purchased, 1 internal-staff-issued
    
- 4 Premium Payments: 3 successful (activate policies), 1 failed (audit-only)
    
- 1 full Claim lifecycle: Submitted -> Internal Staff Review (Recommended Approval) -> Admin Decision (Approved)
    

HOW IDS ARE CHAINED: every create/register/login request has a Postman 'Tests' script that saves IDs, tokens, and reference numbers into collection variables (e.g. {{productHealthId}}, {{policy1Number}}, {{customer1Token}}). Later requests reference those same variables, so running the collection top-to-bottom (e.g. via Collection Runner) produces one consistent, connected demo dataset.

MANUAL STEPS (cannot be automated - real integrations): customer registration OTP verification (real email + Twilio SMS), forgot/reset password (real email token), and the standalone OTP utility endpoints. Each of those requests is clearly marked 'MANUAL STEP REQUIRED' in its description with the exact collection variable to replace before sending.

Base URL defaults to [http://localhost:8080](http://localhost:8080) (see application.properties, server.port=8080, no context path).

item.name: 1. Authentication

request.description: Public customer registration (FR-AUTH-001). Only customer accounts can self-register (ASM-003). After this call, real OTPs are sent to the email and mobile number configured in application.properties (Resend / Twilio). Check that inbox/phone, then use 'Verify Registration OTP (Customer 1)'.
Resends the email + phone OTP for a pending registration if the original OTP expired (5 min validity).

MANUAL STEP REQUIRED: replace {{customer1EmailOtp}} and {{customer1PhoneOtp}} collection variables with the real 6-digit codes received by email/SMS before sending. On success this activates the customer's User account and returns the UserResponseDTO.
Public customer registration for demo customer 2.
MANUAL STEP REQUIRED: fill in real OTPs received by customer 2's email/phone before sending.
Public customer registration for demo customer 3 (used for the internal-staff-issued policy example).
MANUAL STEP REQUIRED: fill in real OTPs received by customer 3's email/phone before sending.
Logs in the default admin seeded by DataInitializer (admin@gmail.com / admin123).
Convenience lookup to populate {{adminUserId}}, used later by the Claim Status History filter example.
Run this AFTER 'Create Internal Staff Account' in the Users folder.
Run this AFTER Customer 1's registration OTP has been verified.
Run this AFTER Customer 2's registration OTP has been verified.
Run this AFTER Customer 3's registration OTP has been verified.
Triggers a real password-reset email containing a reset token/OTP. The response is a generic message regardless of whether the email exists, to prevent user enumeration (see AuthController).
MANUAL STEP REQUIRED: replace {{resetToken}} with the real token received by email after Forgot Password.

item.description: Registration, OTP-based verification, login, and password reset. Admin login works immediately (seeded by DataInitializer). Customer registration requires a real email/SMS OTP - see each request's description.

item.name: 2. OTP Verification (Standalone)

request.description: Sends a real Twilio Verify SMS OTP to a 10-digit Indian mobile number not yet registered.
MANUAL STEP REQUIRED: replace the otp value with the real code received via SMS.
Sends a real email OTP (independent of the registration flow) to the given address.
MANUAL STEP REQUIRED: replace the otp value with the real code received via email.

item.description: Generic OTP send/verify utility endpoints, independent of the registration flow.

Admin re-activates a previously deactivated user account (FR-USER-002).

item.name: 7. Policies

request.description: Customer purchases the Health Shield Basic plan (FR-POL-001). Customer identity is derived from the JWT, not from the request body. Policy is created with PENDING_PAYMENT status (POL-BR-004).
Customer 2 purchases the Motor Secure Comprehensive plan.

item.name: Issue Policy (Internal Staff issues Life plan to Customer 3)

request.description: Internal Staff/Admin issue a policy directly on behalf of a customer (FR-POL-002).
Customers can only view their own policies (FR-POL-006 / POL-BR-009).
Fetches full policy detail by internal ID.
Fetches policy detail using the business-facing policy number.
Admin-only paginated listing of every policy system-wide (FR-POL-011).
Admin/Internal Staff view all policies belonging to a specific customer (FR-POL-007).
Filters policies by lifecycle status: PENDING_PAYMENT, ACTIVE, EXPIRED, or CANCELLED.

item.name: Get Policies By Customer And Status

request.description: Combined filter: policies for one customer restricted to a given status.
Text search on the policy number field.
Returns the policy list visible to the logged-in internal staff member.

Admin/Internal Staff cancel a policy (FR-POL-008). Cancelled policies cannot be reactivated (POL-BR-007) and cannot accept new claims (PLC-RUL-006). Only run this against Policy 3 in this demo, since Policy 1 is needed ACTIVE for the claims examples below.

item.description: Policy purchase (customer self-service) and issuance (internal staff/admin), plus lifecycle queries and cancellation.

item.name: 8. Premium Payments

request.description: Customer records their own simulated premium payment (FR-PAY-001). A successful payment equal to the required premium activates the policy (PAYBR-007).
Customer 2 pays the required premium for their Motor Secure Comprehensive policy.

item.name: Record Payment (Internal Staff records on behalf of Customer 3)

request.description: Internal staff can record simulated payments on behalf of customers (FR-PAY-002).
Demonstrates a failed payment record: stored for audit but must NOT activate/affect the policy (PAYBR-005 / FR-PAY-007).
Customers can view payment history only for their own policies (FR-PAY-008 / PAYBR-009).
Fetches a single payment record by its ID.
Lists all payment records recorded against a specific policy.
Admin/Internal Staff filter payments by status: SUCCESS, FAILED, or PENDING.
Text search on the unique transaction reference field.
Returns the premium payment records handled/visible to Admin/Internal Staff.

item.description: Simulated premium payment records; a successful required payment activates the linked policy.

item.name: 9. Claims
Raise Claim (Customer 1 against active Health Policy)

request.description: Customer raises a claim against their own ACTIVE policy (CLM-BR-001/006, FR-CLM-001). Run this only AFTER 'Record Payment (Customer 1 - Success...)' has activated Policy 1. Claim amount must not exceed the plan's coverage amount (CLM-BR-004).
Only an internal staff member can review and recommend a claim decision (CLC-RUL-002/003, FR-CLM-006/007).
Only an admin can make the final claim decision (CLC-RUL-004, FR-CLM-008). Approved claims cannot be modified again (CLM-BR-009).
Fetches complete claim details; customers may view only their own claims (FR-CLM-005).
Admin-only paginated listing of every claim system-wide (FR-CLM-011).
Admin/Internal Staff view every claim raised by a specific customer.
Filters claims by lifecycle status: SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, RECOMMENDED_APPROVAL, RECOMMENDED_REJECTION, APPROVED, REJECTED.
Text search on the unique claim number field.
Returns claims available for the logged-in internal staff member to review (ASM-009: all internal staff can view claims requiring review).
Customers can view only their own claims (FR-CLM-005).
Redirects (302) to the stored document reference URL; enforces the 'own claims only' boundary for customers.

item.description: Full claim lifecycle: submission by customer, internal staff review/recommendation, and admin final decision.

request.description: Chronological log of every status transition for a claim, visible to admin, internal staff, and the owning customer (HIS-BR-004).
Admin/Internal Staff: history of status changes performed by a specific internal user.
Admin/Internal Staff: history entries filtered by the resulting claim status.

item.name: Claim Status History (Filter by Claim + User + Status)

request.description: Admin/Internal Staff: combined lookup matching a specific claim, acting user, and resulting status.

item.description: Read-only audit trail of every claim status transition.

item.name: 11. File Upload

request.description: Uploads a real file (e.g. discharge summary PDF/image) to Cloudinary and returns its fileUrl. In Postman, click 'Select Files' on the 'file' form field before sending. The returned fileUrl can then be used as documentReference when raising a claim (ASM-005 / DOC-BR-002/003).

item.description: Optional real file upload to Cloudinary used to obtain a document reference URL for claims.
